scripts.check:supabase-functions: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const tests=fs.globSync('supabase/functions/*/index_test.ts').map(p=>p.split('/').at(-2)).sort();const code=fs.globSync('supabase/functions/*/index.ts').map(p=>p.split('/').at(-2)).sort();if(!code.length||JSON.stringify(tests)!==JSON.stringify(code)){console.error('Every Supabase function must have an index and index_test');process.exit(1)}" && deno check supabase/functions/*/index.ts
scripts.test:supabase-functions: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const tests=fs.globSync('supabase/functions/*/index_test.ts').map(p=>p.split('/').at(-2)).sort();const code=fs.globSync('supabase/functions/*/index.ts').map(p=>p.split('/').at(-2)).sort();if(!tests.length||JSON.stringify(tests)!==JSON.stringify(code)){console.error('Every Supabase function must have an index and index_test');process.exit(1)}" && deno test supabase/functions/*/index_test.ts
